title: FCC IdP token lifetime policy
description: SSOT for the OIDC IdP token lifetime values that the Keycloak (or production IdP) realm import MUST match byte-identity. Sprint S2-β α-9 added the schema so a future hand-edit of the JSON cannot drop a field, change a type, or introduce a typo silently.

accessTokenLifespanSeconds.description: Access-token TTL. minimum=60s (OAuth 2.0 Security BCP draft-ietf-oauth-security-topics § 4.13 floor for usability — values below this storm the IdP). maximum=14400s/4h (BCP § 4.13 upper bound for short-lived tokens before refresh becomes mandatory). Dev uses 600s (10 min) to exercise silent refresh frequently.

ssoSessionIdleSeconds.description: Idle timeout before SSO session expires. minimum=60s (NIST SP 800-63B § 7.2 minimum to avoid spurious reauth on legitimate brief idle). maximum=86400s/24h (BCP draft-ietf-oauth-security-topics § 4 idle session ceiling). NIST SP 800-63B § 7.2 reauth-on-idle guidance.

ssoSessionMaxSeconds.description: Absolute session lifetime ceiling. minimum=60s (smoke-test floor). maximum=86400s/24h (NIST SP 800-63B § 7.2 'reauthentication SHALL be performed at least every 12 hours' worst-case interpretation, doubled for end-of-shift handover scenarios).
